article.title: JAPAN AI以兩支B2B廣告訴求落地支援，「三個月成果」另設明確定義
article.title_en: JAPAN AI promotes implementation support in two B2B ads, qualifying its three-month message
article.summary: 11月4日日文公告安排11月起投放網上及交通廣告，強調平台配合專家支援。
article.summary_en: The November 4 Japanese release schedules web and transit advertising from November, combining a platform with expert support.
highlights: 兩支30秒廣告分別呈現落地支援及員工知識轉成AI代理。
原文註明三個月指營運與量度啟動，須符合條件，並非收入保證。
highlights_en: Two 30-second ads present implementation support and agents built from employee expertise.
The footnote defines conditional three-month results as starting operations and measurement, not guaranteed revenue.
article.why: B2B AI品牌可參考它如何把軟件功能轉成服務承諾，同時清楚界定承諾的交付範圍。
article.why_en: B2B AI brands can examine how software features become a service promise with a clearly defined delivery scope.
article.next_step: 檢查自身廣告中的時間與成果字眼，讓主標、註腳、銷售簡報及合約採用同一定義。
article.next_step_en: Align time-and-outcome claims across headlines, footnotes, sales decks and contracts.
article.detail: 這篇是品牌溝通案例，沒有已核實的獲客增長結果。日文原稿清楚解釋，「成果」是開始營運及效果量度，三個月視乎條件與項目而異，不保證三個月內增加銷售或利潤。若只看英文行業報道的宣傳摘要，容易把這句理解成業績承諾。本報採用11月4日原始公告日期，並保留11月分階段投放安排，未聲稱曾觀看或實測相關服務。
article.detail_en: This is a communications case, not verified acquisition performance. The Japanese footnote limits the three-month promise to operational and measurement launch, conditional on the project, and excludes guaranteed sales or profit. The original release date is November 4, with phased November distribution.
article.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
